extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Aetna plan available in Duval County has a $40 monthly premium, a $370 drug deductible and a $4200 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent followed all compliance rules, delivered the disclaimer before discussing benefits, and collected the Scope of Appointment. The appointment was scheduled for 48 hours later.
composition.coaching_note: Great job, Tamika! You effectively followed all the necessary steps and delivered the disclaimer before discussing benefits. One improvement would be to ensure the customer has a clear understanding of the plan details before scheduling the appointment. For example, you could ask if they have any questions about the plan before setting the appointment.

crm_record.next_step: Follow up with customer on the scheduled appointment and ensure they have reviewed the plan details.
